brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres, dampers, and the airflow path for Underhill Hollow 230/34kV to clear any blockage exceeding one quarter of the free area, prove full damper travel, and check for recirculation [SOP-015]. Apply ambient and reduced-cooling de-rating as required, recording every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period [MG-021]. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
